claims.text:
17. hierarchical-cut

Target / packet: ai-hierarchical-cut · C1. Prerequisites: ai:k-means-clustering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: k-means-clustering → bad-start-kmeans. K-means has centroids; this computes merge heights under single versus complete linkage and changes the cut.

Finite primary model: Single-link agglomeration on points [0,1,4,8] merges at heights 1,3,4. Cut retaining merges at height<=2 gives groups{0,1},{4},{8}; cutoff 3 gives{0,1,4},{8}.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Complete-link on same points merges 0/1 at 1, then{0,1}with 4 at 4, so cutoff 3 has three groups. Linkage rule changes meaning of height.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict number of groups at cut 3; recall why same cut differs under complete versus single link.

Required observable evidence: Tiny 4 leaf dendrogram and explicitly declared linkage distance; not a new multi-card sequence.

Source obligation: [scikit-learn clustering documentation](https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/clustering.html), acquired method body §§2.3.2 k-means,2.3.6 hierarchical methods,2.3.7 DBSCAN. Each local convention and actual result is independently derivable; do not infer true populations from requested groups.
 Shipped local model and displayed expression addresses: model.ts compute; Demo.tsx Figure; Stage retained computed witnesses.
